name: Lamu Old Town
description: Lamu Old Town sits on Lamu Island off Kenya's northern coast, reached by boat across a channel from the mainland. It is East Africa's oldest and best-preserved Swahili town, a maze of narrow lanes lined with coral-stone and mangrove-timber houses, shaded courtyards, and carved wooden doors. Its seafront fort, 23 mosques, and donkey sanctuary add to the town's character.
